steps.action: Sign in as the lab Administrator (setup)
steps.actual: Signed in through /auth/login; the banner shows the Administrator's display name.

steps.action: Setup: invite a fictional Legal Team Member and activate the account through the set-password email
steps.actual: Administrator invited doc028.member+1789552837355@example.com as legal_team_member over the API; Mailpit delivered "Set your OpenLaw password"; the member set a password on the activation page and signed in through /auth/login.

steps.action: Before you start: open Auto-Docs and create an Auto-Doc, then open its Form section
steps.actual: Created Auto-Doc "DOC-028 Admin Services Agreement 1789552837355" (id 01a0a9a9-4c03-7427-90f6-db771bdec95e) with Create Auto-Doc > Name > Create; it opened on its record. The Form tab shows the template pane reading "Upload a Word file to start the form." beside the form, with an Upload version button as the guide says.

steps.action: Upload a .docx with Placeholders, one directive, and one Block with Upload version
steps.actual: Dialog caption read "Each upload adds a file version. A new Placeholder gets a form field; a removed one leaves its field in place.". After Upload the dialog reported "File version 1: 8 Placeholders, 1 Block. 6 form fields created." and closed with Close.

steps.action: Read the template pane: every Placeholder and Block is marked, including header, footer, and footnote
steps.actual: Pane heading shows the filename with pill "File version 1" and summary "8 Placeholders, 1 Block". Chips: ["{{counterparty_name}}","{{signing_date}}","{{fee_amount|currency:USD}}","{{governing_law}}","{{arbitration_seat}}","{{reference_code}}","{{counterparty_name}}","{{counterparty_name}}"]. Header chips ["Placeholder counterparty_name"], Footer chips ["Placeholder reference_code"], Footnotes chips ["Placeholder counterparty_name"]. Block tag reads "arbitration · always" and the close reads "end arbitration". Form fields in list order: ["Counterparty name","Signing date","Fee amount","Governing law","Arbitration seat","Reference code","the rule for arbitration"]. At 1280 px the file pane (x=49) sits left of the Fields region (x=720).

steps.action: A directive decides the new field's type: currency directive created a Currency field, others Text
steps.actual: Selecting the fee_amount chip opened its card; Type shows "Currency". The governing_law card's Type shows "Text".

steps.action: Select a field from its chip and edit the label, type, and help from its card; the form follows each commit
steps.actual: Clicking the chip marked it selected (aria-pressed) and opened the field card with controls ["Label:1","Slug:1","Type:1","Help text:1"]. Changing Label to "Counterparty legal name" and pressing Enter renamed the card and the Fields list (["Counterparty legal name","Signing date","Fee amount","Governing law","Arbitration seat","Reference code","the rule for arbitration"]). Help text saved as "Use the registered company name.".

steps.action: Write a Clause rule: open the Block under Clauses, choose When a rule matches, pick field, operator, value
steps.actual: Clauses section notes "A Block with no rule is always included.". Block tag read "arbitration · always" before the rule. Include offered ["Always","When a rule matches"]; after choosing "When a rule matches", Form field "Governing law", Operator "Equals", Value "England and Wales" the tag reads "arbitration · when Governing law equals England and Wales" and the Clauses row reads "Included when Governing law equals England and Wales".

steps.action: Negative: Publish refuses a field that cannot print its directive and names it (currency directive on a Text field)
steps.actual: With Fee amount set to Text, Publish offered ["File version 1"] / ["Form version 6","Form version 5","Form version 4","Form version 3","Form version 2","Form version 1"] and refused with "This pair cannot be published. Set \"Fee amount\" to a currency or number field for Placeholder \"{{fee_amount|currency:USD}}\".". State stayed "Draft". Type was then set back to Currency.

steps.action: Negative: an upload with an open Block is refused and the refusal quotes the text
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc028-unclosed-block.docx with "Unclosed Block: \"{{#block arbitration}}\""; the pane still shows "File version 1".

steps.action: Negative: an upload with an unclosed brace is refused and the refusal quotes the text
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc028-unclosed-brace.docx with "Unclosed Placeholder brace: \"{{counterparty_name on the date below.\""; the pane still shows "File version 1".

steps.action: Supplementary: an unknown currency code is refused and the refusal quotes the text
steps.actual: Upload version refused doc028-bad-currency.docx with "Use a supported currency code: \"{{fee_amount|currency:ZZZ}}\"".

steps.action: Upload a new version that drops a Placeholder; the orphaned field is kept and marked
steps.actual: Dialog reported "File version 2: 8 Placeholders, 1 Block. 1 form field created. 1 field has no Placeholder now.". Pane shows "File version 2" with "Earlier versions (1)". Fields list ["Counterparty legal name","Signing date","Fee amount","Governing law","Arbitration seat","Reference code","Notice address","the rule for arbitration"]; the Signing date row is marked "No Placeholder in file version 2" and the Form tab reads "Form1".

steps.action: Publish pins one file version and one form version together
steps.actual: Publish dialog offered file versions ["File version 2","File version 1"] and form versions ["Form version 8","Form version 7","Form version 6","Form version 5","Form version 4","Form version 3","Form version 2","Form version 1"] with caption "Later edits leave this pair unchanged until you publish again."; the newest form "Form version 8" was preselected (checked option "Form version 8"). Chose File version 2 and published; the header state reads Published and Overview reads "Live since Sep 16, 2026: file version 2, form version 8.".

steps.action: Later edits change nothing live until you publish again
steps.actual: After editing a Help text, Overview still reads "Live since Sep 16, 2026: file version 2, form version 8." and warns "Form version 9 is newer than the currently published form.".

steps.action: The Help link on the template pane resolves to this article
steps.actual: Link href "/help/auto-doc-template" opened /auto-docs/01a0a9a9-4c03-7427-90f6-db771bdec95e/form with h1 "Write an Auto-Doc template" and sections ["Before you start","Mark a Placeholder","Format a value","Mark a Block","Upload a new version"].

steps.action: Keyboard: reach a Placeholder chip with Tab and select it with Enter; open and close Upload version with the keyboard
steps.actual: Tab reached "Placeholder counterparty_name" after 3 presses (focus outline style "solid"); Enter set aria-pressed="true" and its card visible=false. Enter on Upload version opened the dialog (focus inside: true); Escape closed it.

steps.action: Narrow layout: the Form section and the Help article at 390 px wide
steps.actual: Form section at 390 px: scrollWidth 390 vs clientWidth 390; Upload version visible=true, Help link visible=true, 8 chips rendered. Help article at 390 px: scrollWidth 390 vs clientWidth 390.

steps.action: Supplementary: two directives that disagree on one name create a Text field and Publish names the gap
steps.actual: Upload reported "File version 1: 2 Placeholders, 0 Blocks. 1 form field created."; Fee amount Type shows "Text"; Publish refused with "This pair cannot be published. Set \"Fee amount\" to a currency or number field for Placeholder \"{{fee_amount|currency:USD}}\". Set \"Fee amount\" to a date field for Placeholder \"{{fee_amount|date:YYYY-MM-DD}}\".".
